checks.name: neumann_agreement
checks.claim: Thm 12.1: BSP event positions track s(t) = 2*lam*sqrt(alpha t)
checks.value: mean rel err 2.939% (max 4.937%, 19 events in window)
checks.detail: measured on the mid-window events (start-up excluded); the convergence check below is the dx -> 0 statement

checks.name: convergence
checks.claim: Thm 12.1 (dx -> 0): BSP event times converge to Neumann
checks.detail: grids dx = 1.000, 0.500, 0.250 mm; node-pinned front tracking is expected to be ~1st order

checks.name: enthalpy_agreement
checks.claim: independent benchmark: apparent-capacity enthalpy method (refined grid dx/4)
checks.detail: two independent discretizations agreeing is the strongest simple evidence of correctness

checks.name: energy_conservation
checks.claim: Thm 13.2: energy conserved at each trace event up to the boundary flux (E_after - E_before + Q_out = 0)
checks.value: max per-event drift 0.518% of one cell's latent; cumulative drift 0.105% of total latent exchanged
checks.detail: event 1 excluded: it carries the null-transit fare (first cell's latent + boundary-cell chill), O(dx), a start-up payment rather than a conservation failure

checks.name: second_law
checks.claim: Thm 14.1: entropy production dS = k (grad T)^2 / T^2 dt >= 0, cumulative S monotone
checks.value: min dS = 0.000e+00 J/(m2 K), S(t_end) = 1445.4666 J/(m2 K), monotone: True
checks.detail: dS uses the paper's formula with absolute temperature and the dx volume element added (per-unit area)

checks.name: sharp_interface
checks.claim: Prop 9.3 (tau^2 = 0): the boundary marker never smears -- exactly one interface node at all times
checks.value: interface nodes at end: 1; front advances node-by-node (all dp = 1): True
checks.detail: the trace layer c is 0/1 by construction and tau^2 = 0 keeps multiplication from smearing it (uc_algebra below)

checks.name: trace_clock
checks.claim: Prop 9.2: time emerges from trace events -- strictly increasing, non-uniform clock ticks
checks.value: 29 events, dt in [9.2, 2.6e+02] s (span ratio 28.8), decelerating front captured without any adaptive time-step controller
checks.detail: for a sqrt(t) front the intervals grow linearly with event index; the uniform-grid alternative would need dt small enough for the fastest early event

checks.name: null_transit
checks.claim: monograph sec. 2.7.1 via bsp.nodes: nilpotent, irreversible, trace-preserving layer switch at node 0
checks.value: fare_1 = 334109.0 vs expected 334109.0 (0.00% of rho L dx); visited record d = 1 on all 30 visited nodes: True; one-way transits: True; max crossing residual 1.10e-09 dx
checks.tolerance: fare within 2%, record complete, one-way, residual < 1e-3 dx
checks.detail: the start-up node-0 conflict (boundary layer T_s vs interface layer T_m) is resolved by dynamic layer switching; the fare is O(dx) and vanishes in the convergence limit

checks.name: uc_algebra
checks.claim: sec. 3: UC algebra with tau^2 = 0 (sharp interface encoding)
checks.value: tau^2 = 0 exactly: True; Prop 3.2's printed product deviates from the algebra it defines by up to 5.914 (tau-real) / 15.317 (tau-imag) on random samples (value parts agree)
checks.detail: bsp.uc implements the correct Leibniz product; the paper's Prop 3.2 drops the -bd'-b'd contribution and flips a sign -- see the audit report

checks.name: lattice_counts
checks.claim: sec. 4: 1DB = 117 = 9 + 27 + 81 points, 2DB = 243 positions, value tables as printed
checks.value: 1DB points: 117, L-table match: True, M-table match: True, 2DB zone accounting: (351, 243)
checks.detail: finding: the lattices are sound combinatorial objects but Algorithm 9.1 never uses them (it runs on a plain uniform lattice); they are not load-bearing for the solver
